WinDivert 2.2.2
===============

This directory holds the Windows x64 binary distribution of WinDivert
(https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html), used by the qeli Windows client for
per-app split tunnelling (NETWORK-layer packet divert).

Upstream project: https://github.com/basil00/Divert
Version bundled:  2.2.2
Files:            WinDivert.dll, WinDivert64.sys

License
-------
WinDivert is dual-licensed under your choice of:
  - GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL) Version 3, or
  - GNU General Public License (GPL) Version 2

LICENSE.txt in this directory is copied verbatim from the official 2.2.2
release and contains the complete LGPLv3, GPLv3 and GPLv2 texts.

The qeli Windows client (MPL-2.0 sources) dynamically loads WinDivert.dll at
runtime. The redistributed application that ships the embedded WinDivert
binaries must comply with the chosen WinDivert license (LGPL-3.0 or GPL-2.0).

Provenance
----------
Canonical copy:  native-libs/third-party/windows-x64/windivert/
Consumed copy:   qeli-win/QeliWin/windivert/  (EmbeddedResource → single-file exe)
Hashes:          native-libs/SHA256SUMS (both paths must match; verified by verify.sh)

Do not rebuild these binaries from this tree — download the official 2.2.2
release from https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html and replace both copies, then
run:  bash native-libs/verify.sh --update
